'''Forest Song''' is located in northeastern [[Ashenvale]], just northeast of [[Satyrnaar]], north of the [[Warsong Lumber Camp]], and southwest of [[Bough Shadow]]. It is an ancient [[Kaldorei]] ruin, inhabited by a sole night elf - [[Kayneth Stillwind]]. Although the scenery is beautiful and no danger appears to be lurking here, there is a certain sense of foreboding about the ruins. The air hangs dark and ominous over the area, and the usual forest sounds are still.
